patterns.note: Content is primarily centered within a maximum width, with full-width background sections providing visual separation and distinct styling.
A highly stylized, blocky, uppercase display font is used for prominent headings, creating a strong brand identity, contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.

Product cards utilize distinct, soft pastel-like background colors (purple, dark grey, yellow) against a light off-white main page background, creating visual interest and differentiation for each offering.
The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Product offerings are presented as a horizontal grid of visually distinct cards, each with a unique background color and a clear call to action, encouraging exploration of the Pika suite.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is implemented with a sticky position, ensuring it remains visible at the top of the viewport during scrolling. Other content sections, such as the product cards and footer, reveal by simply scrolling into view as the user progresses down the page.

The hero section features a prominent, bold, uppercase display font for the main headline, setting a strong visual tone that is balanced by a more subdued, clean sans-serif for supporting text and input fields.

Product features are encapsulated within distinct card components, each using a unique background color to visually separate and highlight individual offerings, with clear action buttons for engagement.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized bold uppercase display heading (~4x body) with clean sans-serif body text and small uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: subtle rounding on input fields and buttons, with more pronounced rounding on product cards.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced, with generous vertical spacing between main sections, but tighter within content blocks like the product cards.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a highly stylized, blocky, uppercase display font for its main headings immediately grabs attention, creating a bold and playful brand identity. This is effectively contrasted with clean body text and vibrant, uniquely colored product cards, making the site feel both modern and approachable.
